sentences.text:
Ms. Medha Pandey vs Jitendra Singh on 10 April, 2024
Author: Rakesh Thapliyal

Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
Sl. Date reports,
No. orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order
S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No. 627 of 2024  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Ms. Medha Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey and Ms. Meenakshi Sharma, learned Brief Holders for the State.

3. By the present C482 application, the applicant is challenging the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 5031 of 2022, State vs. Jitendra Singh Chauhan, arising out of FIR No. 04 of 2021, P.S.
Dalanwala, District Dehradun wherein the present applicant is facing trial for the offences punishable under Sections, 498A, 323 and 504 IPC and under Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun.
4.
The facts of the case are that applicant married with respondent no. 2 on 08.03.2020 as per Hindu customs and rights.

It is submitted that after marriage respondent no.2 started to create pressure upon the applicant's family to transfer the property in her name and when they refused then respondent no. 2 started harassing the applicant and his family members and she also aborted about 17 weeks pregnancy without permission of the applicant.

5. It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant also lodged the FIR against respondent no. 2 and her family members on 12.04.2021 wherein after investigation charge sheet has been filed for the offences punishable under Section 312, 384 and 120B IPC in which after taking cognizance summons were issued and the case was registered as Criminal Case No. 3424 of 2022,
State vs. Akshi Bisht & others.
6. It is contended that proceedings of the said Criminal Case No. 3424 of 2022 is stayed by this Court in C482 No. 2020 of 2022.

It is also submitted that respondent no. 2 has also lodged the FIR against the applicant and his family members on 10.01.2021 raising the allegations that the applicant and his family members harassing her for the demand of dowry.

This FIR was registered Ms. Medha Pandey vs Jitendra Singh on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24369911/
1 as FIR No. 4 of 2021 at P.S. Dalanwala District Dehradun for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and under Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and on 06.09.2021, after investigation charge sheet was filed and on 08.07.2022, the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun took cognizance and summoned the applicant.
It is submitted that the proceedings as initiated in Criminal Case No. 5031 of 2022, arising out of FIR lodged by respondent no. 2 being FIR No. 4 of 2021 is nothing but an abuse of process of law.

7. After taking into consideration the allegations and counter allegations in the FIR lodged by the present applicant as well as respondent no. 2 it appears that the dispute between the parties is a matrimonial dispute, therefore an attempt should be made to settle their dispute.

8. Put up this matter on 25.04.2024 along with C482 No. 2020 of 2022.
9.
On that day the applicant and respondent no. 2 shall remain present in the Court.
10. In the meantime, further proceedings of Criminal Case No. 5031 of 2022, State vs. Jitendra Singh Chauhan, pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun shall remain stayed.
